params.name: league.market.backoutChance
params.constrainedBy: C8.2.1 edge case: a player who agrees in the window backs out with a starting 2 percent chance (Assumption in the bible). Test "window agreement backout"

params.name: league.market.firstWaveHours
params.constrainedBy: C8.2.1 rule 4: the first wave is a starting 72 hours. Acceptance: 60 percent of guaranteed money in the first 72 hours (Unverified target). Test "market rounds"

params.name: league.market.roundIntervalHours
params.constrainedBy: C8.2.1 rule 3 says rounds are a few hours apart in the window and the first three days; 4 hours is this module's reading. Test "market rounds"

params.name: league.market.hourlyRoundDaysAfterOpen
params.constrainedBy: C8.2.1 rule 3: rounds a few hours apart through the first three days, then daily. Test "market rounds"

params.name: league.market.dailyRoundHour
params.constrainedBy: Hour of day (Eastern) the daily rounds resolve after the first days; noon is this module's choice. Test "market rounds"

params.name: league.market.demandOneSuitor
params.constrainedBy: C8.3.1 rule 2: demand factor 0.85 with one suitor (starting). Test "demand factor"

params.name: league.market.demandFullSuitors
params.constrainedBy: C8.3.1 rule 2: demand factor 1.25 with five or more suitors (starting). Test "demand factor"

params.name: league.market.demandFullSuitorCount
params.constrainedBy: C8.3.1 rule 2: five or more suitors give the full factor. Test "demand factor"

params.name: league.market.timeDiscountFirst
params.constrainedBy: C8.3.1 rule 4: expected pay falls a starting 10 percent after the first wave. Test "time discount"

params.name: league.market.timeDiscountPerMonth
params.constrainedBy: C8.3.1 rule 4: and 5 percent more per month (starting). Test "time discount"

params.name: league.market.daysPerMonth
params.constrainedBy: A market month for the C8.3.1 time discount; 30 days is this module's reading. Test "time discount"

params.name: league.market.pooledScaleMinContracts
params.constrainedBy: C8.3.1 edge case: a position with fewer than a starting 10 contracts uses a pooled scale with a neighbouring position. Test "pooled scale"

params.name: league.market.maxContractYears
params.constrainedBy: C8.3.1 rule 3 gives no ceiling for years offered; 5 is this module's choice (the proration limit, C6.2.2, makes longer deals rare). Test "expected years"

params.name: league.market.guaranteeShareTop
params.constrainedBy: C8.3.1 rule 3: guarantee share falls with age and injury flags; no source for the level. Share at the top of the scale, in prime. Calibrate when a contract dataset is in the project (C8.3.1 open question). Test "guarantee share"

params.name: league.market.guaranteeShareBottom
params.constrainedBy: Guarantee share at the bottom of the position scale; same open question as guaranteeShareTop. Test "guarantee share"

params.name: league.market.guaranteeAgeDropPerYear
params.constrainedBy: Guarantee share lost per year of age past the position's prime (C8.3.1 rule 3); no source. Test "guarantee share"

params.name: league.market.guaranteeInjuryFactor
params.constrainedBy: Guarantee share multiplier for a player with an injury flag (C8.3.1 rule 3, D11); no source. Test "guarantee share"

params.name: league.market.weightMoney
params.constrainedBy: C8.3.2 rule 1: median player's weight on guaranteed money, starting 0.5. Test "median weights"

params.name: league.market.weightRole
params.constrainedBy: C8.3.2 rule 1: role, starting 0.15. Test "median weights"

params.name: league.market.weightWinning
params.constrainedBy: C8.3.2 rule 1: chance to win, starting 0.1. Test "median weights"

params.name: league.market.weightRelationships
params.constrainedBy: C8.3.2 rule 1: relationships, starting 0.1. Test "median weights"

params.name: league.market.weightScheme
params.constrainedBy: C8.3.2 rule 1: scheme fit, starting 0.1. Test "median weights"

params.name: league.market.weightLocation
params.constrainedBy: C8.3.2 rule 1: location, starting 0.05. Test "median weights"

params.name: league.market.weightMoneyMax
params.constrainedBy: C8.3.2 rule 1: a money-first player weights money up to 0.8. Test "weights validation"

params.name: league.market.weightWinningMax
params.constrainedBy: C8.3.2 rule 1: a veteran chasing a title weights winning up to 0.4. Test "weights validation"

params.name: league.market.oldClubTermMax
params.constrainedBy: C8.3.2 rule 5: the old club gets a small relationship term; its largest size is this module's choice. Test "old club term"

params.name: league.market.nonMoneyOffsetMaxShare
params.constrainedBy: M5.2.1 rule 4: non-money terms can offset a gap of up to 10 percent in guaranteed money for a median player (starting). Test "money gap cap"

params.name: league.market.pitchGeneralGain
params.constrainedBy: M5.2.1 rule 1: a matching pitch raises the role, scheme or relationship term; size is Assumption in the bible. Test "pitch"

params.name: league.market.pitchSpecificPromiseGain
params.constrainedBy: M5.2.1 rule 2: a specific promise raises the role term more than a general one; size Assumption. Test "pitch"

params.name: league.market.pitchFilmGain
params.constrainedBy: M5.2.1 rule 3: showing plays raises the scheme term by actual fit; this is the gain at perfect fit. Test "pitch"

params.name: league.market.untouchableTopN
params.constrainedBy: C8.4.1 rule 7: the general manager marks as untouchable any player with surplus in the club's top 5 (starting). Test "untouchables"

params.name: league.market.contenderFuturePickDiscount
params.constrainedBy: C8.4.1 rule 6: a contending club discounts future picks; size is this module's choice. Test "window adjustment"

params.name: league.market.rebuilderVeteranDiscount
params.constrainedBy: C8.4.1 rule 6: a rebuilding club discounts older players; size is this module's choice. Test "window adjustment"

params.name: league.market.veteranAge
params.constrainedBy: Age from which a rebuilding club discounts a player (C8.4.1 rule 6 says older players); this module's choice. Test "window adjustment"

params.name: league.market.physicalFailChance
params.constrainedBy: C8.4.1 edge case: a failed physical voids the trade with a starting 2 percent chance when the player carries an injury flag (Assumption). Test "physical"

params.name: league.market.buyAboveOddsPct
params.constrainedBy: C8.4.2 rule 1: buy above a starting 55 percent playoff odds. Test "deadline stance"

params.name: league.market.sellBelowOddsPct
params.constrainedBy: C8.4.2 rule 1: sell below 15 percent. Test "deadline stance"

params.name: league.market.habitShiftPctPerStep
params.constrainedBy: C8.4.2 rule 1: thresholds shift by the general manager's habits and job security; points of odds per step of habit is this module's choice. Test "deadline stance"

params.name: league.market.voiceTrustThreshold
params.constrainedBy: C8.4.2 rule 2: the coach's voice moves the stance one step when trust is high; the cut for high is this module's choice. Test "deadline stance"

params.name: league.market.insistFullWeightCount
params.constrainedBy: M5.1.1 rule 2: insist weight full for 2 insists in a period, then halved for each further one (Assumption). Test "voice weights"

params.name: league.market.mustKeepFullWeightCount
params.constrainedBy: M5.3.1 rule 1: must-keep marks count in full up to 3 (starting). Test "voice weights"

params.name: league.market.coreListFullWeightCount
params.constrainedBy: M5.4.1: core list full weight for 5 names (Assumption). Test "voice weights"

params.name: league.market.extraNameWeightFactor
params.constrainedBy: M5.1.1 rule 2: insist weight full for the first insists in a period, then halved for each further one (Assumption). Must-keep and core lists use a per-name share instead (M5.3.1, M5.4.1). Test "voice weights"

params.name: league.market.neutralTerm
params.constrainedBy: Value of a non-money term (role, winning, relationships, scheme, location) that neither attracts nor repels; the player's reservation score uses it. Test "player waits"
